results.title: Mbano ya analyse
results.lowMessage: Maladi na yo ezali te lokola Ebola. Zalá na makanisi mpe kende epai ya monganga soki maladi ekobi.
results.moderateMessage: Maladi mosusu na yo esengeli kolandela na monganga. Kende na centre de santé noki.
results.highMessage: Maladi na yo ezali lokola Ebola. Benga ba services ya santé sikoyo. Kosutaka na bato te.
results.criticalMessage: URGENCE — Maladi na yo emonisi likama makasi ya Ebola. Benga nimero ya urgence sikoyo. Kotambola te kozanga lisalisi ya monganga.

cta.title: Miniti moko moko ezali na ntina
cta.subtitle: Virus ya Ebola epanzanaka noki. Koyeba noki ebikiselaka bomoi. Kozela te.
cta.checkerDescription: Yanolá na mituna moke mpe zwa évaluation ya noki ya likama ya Ebola.
cta.variantWarning: Variant Bundibugyo — bakufi bakoki kokoma 50% · Vaccin ezali te · Koyeba noki esengeli.
cta.emergencySubtitle: Soki yo to moto oyo azali pene na yo azali na maladi ya Ebola, benga ba services ya santé sikoyo.

footer.aboutText: Plateforme ya kolandela mpe kokebisa mpo na bato ya Est ya Congo liboso ya maladi ya Ebola Bundibugyo 2026.
footer.disclaimer: Service oyo ekoki te kosimba toli ya monganga. Mpo na urgence, benga 101.
